correctness.rationale: Stationary marked-Poisson construction makes the X_i conditionally independent Gaussian mixtures given backward inter-event ages S_j; r q S_J is marginal Exp(1), hence the one-coordinate square has mean 1 and variance 5. Conditional mean is V_q=Σq(1-q)^{j-1}E_j, with exact Var(V_q)=q/(2-q) and cross-covariance from conditional independence. For fixed q, the conditional empirical variance is (5-v_q)/N. For q->0, almost-sure geometric Riemann-sum limits of conditional moments (a=1,2,4) establish conditional Lyapunov CLT of the thermal noise; Lindeberg for weighted exponentials yields a second CLT for V_q with max weight / SD ->0. Deterministic conditional characteristic function proves joint independence; normalization works even if Nq_N oscillates, by subsequences. Independently recomputed exact rational stationary moment/covariance equations for four q and four N; these finite checks do not prove CLTs.

value.rationale: A common-reset Brownian gas has a natural collective mean-square radius. The theorem quantifies failure of self-averaging for fixed shared-event participation and proves a sharp intermediate Nq_N~1 crossover with both individual and common-environment Gaussian noise. This is a motivated physical mechanism between established independent-particle and all-particle resetting, not a simple substitution; no fixed-cardinality claim is made.
